searchText: in order to compute the hash of the genesis block if prague is active at genesis, you need to set the requests hash to something. there are no actual requests at genesis, so you'd fill it with `EMPTY_REQUESTS_HASH` it's just an implementation detail Each genesis block is different in many ways regardless; these requests are just one part of that yeah it was an implementation question, not something that would be in the eip. we have the same type of constants for empty trie root, empty keccak hash etc to avoid going through the hasher or trie algo if we're doing nothing for the generic empty requests hash we would need something like MPT where the shape of empty tree doesn't depend on the content's layout Well, what I'm more broadly getting at is whether it's worth compromising the rest of the design around this I'm going to make a proposal for this I think it's worth changing the commitment slightly so that an empty contract output is removed from the list completely. Note this also means we put the prefix byte back into the list on the engine API It's good to have an empty hash that is not fork-dependent.
